text: Instrument the evaluator to count procedure applications, so the cost of a program is visible. Fill in the two blanks.
choices: // ... bind parameters and eval the body
explanation: Verified on the book's interpreter: fib(5) took 15 applications, fib(10) 177, fib(15) 1,973, fib(20) 21,891, fib(25) 242,785. Each step of 5 multiplies the work by about eleven, which is the golden ratio to the fifth power — exponential growth measured rather than asserted, and Chapter 32 confirms the same figure from Java's own naive Fibonacci.
